_note: YOUR OWN SOFTWARE — the products the lab builds and runs.
Add or remove an entry in `items` and the home page grid, the Products
page and the footer's Lab menu all follow.
`status` must be one of: Live, Beta, Alpha, Research. It controls the
colour of the little badge (green, red, orange, blue) as well as the word.

seo.title: Products
seo.description: Sentinel, Forge, Nexus, Prism, and Cipher — five products built, run, and maintained by the {{brand.name}} engineering lab.

hero.title: Five products. All of them ours.
hero.description: We fund these ourselves, run them in production, and answer the pager when they misbehave. Everything we learn doing that ends up in the client work.

_note: The long alternating rows on the Products page.
`domainTemplate` is the fake web address drawn in the mock screenshot —
{name} is replaced by the product's name in lower case.
`secondaryButton` sits next to each product's own button.
`metric` is the big number on the card. `features` are the ticked
lines on the Products page. `cta` is this product's own button.
items.name: Sentinel
items.tagline: Anomaly detection that reads your system like an engineer.
items.description: Sentinel ingests traces, logs, and metrics, then surfaces the three things that actually matter right now — with a plain-language explanation of why.

items.name: Forge
items.tagline: Internal tools in an afternoon, not a quarter.
items.description: Describe the workflow, connect a datasource, and Forge generates a typed, permissioned internal app you can extend with real code.

items.name: Nexus
items.tagline: A runtime for agents that need to be trusted.
items.description: Durable execution, replayable state, and hard budget ceilings for multi-agent systems. Every decision an agent makes is inspectable after the fact.

items.name: Prism
items.tagline: Product analytics that never phones home with PII.
items.description: Cookieless, in-region event analytics with funnels and retention built in. Ships with a warehouse sync so your data stays yours.

items.name: Cipher
items.tagline: Continuous posture checks for teams without a security hire.
items.description: Cipher watches your cloud, repos, and dependencies for drift against a policy baseline, then opens the pull request that fixes it.
